  • Classes in dev.relism.flash.ext.limiter used by dev.relism.flash.ext.limiter
    Class
    Description
    Bucket
    One key's rate-limit state: two AtomicLong slots whose meaning is the strategy's — fixed and sliding windows pack (epoch << 32 | count) in slot0 (sliding keeps the previous window's count in slot1); the token bucket keeps tokens × 1000 and the last refill time.
    KeyResolver
    Who a request counts against: an address, a user, an API key.
    LimitConfig
    Immutable configuration snapshot for a single rate-limit rule.
    LimiterModule
    Rate limits: Limit on a handler class, or LimiterModule.limit(java.lang.String, int, long, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit) as middleware on any route.
    LimitStrategy
    The rate-limit algorithms, by name: @Limit(requests = 100, window = 1, strategy = TOKEN_BUCKET).
    RateLimitStrategy
    A rate-limit algorithm: lock-free (only AtomicLong CAS on the Bucket), stateless (every mutable value lives in the bucket) and allocation-free, since it runs on every request.
